headline: Mont Blanc massif destablilized by summer heatwaves and rockfalls
description: As a result of extreme temperatures, which have weakened both its ice and its rock faces, the highest peak in the Alps is currently inaccessible by any of its three standard climbing routes.

description: Heat waves and the lack of rain have created particularly unfavorable conditions for tiger mosquitoes. But activity is expected to rebound in September as rainfall returns.

headline: An unusual political compromise in Italy could create public body to support film industry
description: MPs will debate a bill in September to establish an 'agency for cinema and audiovisual media' amid budget austerity. However, the plan would still leave significant powers in the hands of political authorities.

description: The series inspired by 'Green Lantern,' one of the oldest superhero comics, revisits the theme of humanity’s protectors as imperfect beings.

headline: Why British Prime Minister Andy Burnham should matter to Europe
description: In a bid to win back his party's traditional base, the new Labour prime minister is focusing on domestic policy. However, his ambitions for industrial revival could pave the way for closer ties with the European Union, observes political scientist Sébastien Maillard.

description: If she were to win, far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has pledged to call a referendum to revise the Constitution and enshrine the far right's core principles in it. According to a member of the highest administrative court, this would be 'a double coup d'état, both in form and content.'

headline: 'The Taliban preach purity and morality, but rush to strip women in prison': A land of terror for Afghan women
description: 'Voices of Afghan Women' (5/6). In Afghanistan, the law now stands against women and girls. Two new decrees issued by the Taliban regime even legalize domestic violence and child marriage.

headline: Mahmoud Darwish and Tamar Ben Ami: The impossible love of a Palestinian poet and an Israeli dancer
description: In the early 1960s, in Haifa, Israel, the young Palestinian poet Mahmoud Darwish fell in love with Tamar Ben Ami, a Jewish Israeli dancer. Their romance was intense but brief. From this forbidden love, the writer composed a poignant poem, 'Rita and the Rifle,' which is still sung throughout the Arab world.
